meaning: The paper's own stated logic between its results, beside Lean's dependencies. Theorem 1.1 is the main result: Sections 2 to 6 prove it from a profile (route 1, from Lean). Section 7 supplies its hypothesis: a certificate gives a profile (Theorem 7.1), so the conclusions of Theorem 1.1 hold (Corollary 7.2) (route 2). Appendix B shows that cell data satisfying its conditions are a certificate (Proposition B.14, from B.1 to B.13); the cell-layer theorem after its proof states the whole chain in Lean (route 3).
